output.summary: KEP-559 proposed a separate mutually exclusive field, subPathExpr, so volume subPaths could be built from environment variables (e.g. per-pod unique log directories) without sidecar init containers. The feature was implemented and reached stable (GA) in Kubernetes 1.17; the KEP status was later flipped to implemented.
output.rationale: Two pods on the same host writing same-named log files to a shared hostPath volume clash, and the existing subPath cannot be set from an env var without a breaking API change. The alpha subPath-from-env approach (VolumeSubPathEnvExpansion) was blocked by backward-compatibility concerns, so a new separate field was chosen. The sources say the new field was delivered and the feature graduated to GA in 1.17, and the KEP was later set to implemented.

alternatives.option: Reuse the existing subPath field and expand env vars in it (alpha VolumeSubPathEnvExpansion)
alternatives.why_not: Breaking change for existing users' subpaths; reviewers (liggitt, thockin) blocked it on backward-compatibility grounds, and msau42 agreed the API concerns were valid.
The KEP says it would fix subPath to a single value and would not allow concatenation such as $(NAMESPACE)/$(POD_NAME).

alternatives.option: Symlinks or sidecar init containers as workarounds
alternatives.why_not: The KEP calls these messy configuration overhead; the goal was to remove the need for complex initContainers.

evidence.quote: The api change proposed is to create a Mutually Exclusive Field separate from the `subPath` called `subPathExpr`
Because of the mentioned breaking changes, this implementation cannot proceed forward
It got moved to a separate field. PR was open at https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/71351 and had lgtm for API
Since this graduated to GA in 1.17, I'd like to close this issue out but the KEP is still marked as implementable.
https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/pull/2598 is the PR that moved this KEP to implemented.
